title: Check in is one tap from the console Home, the sidebar and the phone More sheet

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project chat: still cannot find the check in functions (PR 3 of 3 after LIVE-1175)

detail: FILED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: even with a Check in tab on Offerings (LIVE-1175), the owner had to know to open Money first. THE FIX: the console sidebar has its own Check in row after Money (it falls into the phone More sheet, which lists every row without a bar slot), the console Home has a Check in button beside Edit page and New event, and the Money tab no longer claims the Check in page so only one row lights. See ADR-1871.

verify.note: Fails on main (no Check in row or Home button), passes with this change.
